messages:
alex k: Heads up — found a repro where a streaming request with an in-band tool call + a mid-stream model fallback ends up being charged twice. Reproducer + logs below. cc @maria g @samir

alex k: logs (trimmed):
```
router: request session=abc123 path=route-A -> selected model=gpt-large
runtime: capacity low, initiating fallback to model=gpt-small-q4 mid-request
stream: continued, tool_call invoked
proxy: rewritten tool_call_id 0x1a -> 0x2b after path swap
ledger: provisional_charge: session=abc123 tokens=124 attributed to path=route-A
ledger: confirmed_charge: session=abc123 tokens=124 attributed to path=route-B
```

maria g: interesting. do we keep the same session id across the swap? if session persisted, dedupe should've worked.

samir: I suspect dedupe key uses (path_id + toolcall_id). when path changes, the toolcall_id is regenerated by the proxy, so we lose de-duplication. :eyes: 

jordan: we've seen cases where the proxy assigns a new toolcall id when it re-encodes the toolcall payload during routing. that would explain 0x1a -> 0x2b.

alex k: yes, confirmed. session header `x-rw-session: abc123` is intact in both segments, but `x-rw-path` changed and the tool_call_id mutated. repro curl below:
```
# client starts stream
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "x-rw-session: abc123" -H "x-rw-path: route-A" -d '{"stream":true,"input":"...","toolcall":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
# midway router swaps to route-B (simulated)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "x-rw-session: abc123" -H "x-rw-path: route-B" -d '{"resume":true,"toolcall":true,"tool_call_id":"0x2b"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/resume
```

lucy: could we canonicalize the dedupe to use session + toolcall_nonce instead of path+toolcall_id so swaps don't break it?

maria g: for modern clients we can add an optional header `x-rw-toolcall-nonce` from client side. problem: legacy clients won't set it. backend could synthesize a stable nonce per session (incremental seq in session state).

samir: agree. implementation sketch: server computes `toolcall_stable_id = x-rw-toolcall-nonce || session_id + ':' + toolcall_seq` if header absent. ledger dedupe by stable_id across path changes. also emit telemetry when stable id was synthesized.

alex k: propose next steps:
  1) add optional client header `x-rw-toolcall-nonce` (no client break)
  2) if missing, server generates stable id using session + seq (persist seq in session object)
  3) ledger dedupe by stable id, not path+toolcall_id
  4) console: add attribution view that merges provisional charges across path changes and exposes a `merged_by_stable_id` flag
  5) telemetry event `billing.dedupe.hit` with reason codes: `path-change`, `id-match`, `synthesized-nonce`

jordan: +1. also add unit/integration test that simulates midstream fallback + toolcall and asserts single charge. want to take test, @alex k?

alex k: I'll do prototype + test. @lucy can you review ledger change? also will file an infra issue and attach repro.

lucy: happy to review. please add migration docs noting the optional header and that server may synthesize stable ids for legacy clients. :+1:

ops-bot: Issue created: INF-2345 "stable toolcall ids for midstream fallbacks" assigned to alex k, lucy. Priority: P2

alex k: I'll push a draft PR today and link INF-2345 here. thanks everyone for quick triage.
